front.title: Bridge Contract for Agent Session Governance

abstract.t: Existing agent protocols define identity headers, audit records and session resumption, but none defines what an intermediate bridge MUST do when the client is detached and the agent keeps executing, or when the human in the loop is unavailable. This document defines the Bridge Contract: a Session Identity Descriptor, Mandatory Governance Events, a Resume Record that the bridge keeps for itself, and Conformance Criteria. Re-attach is a challenge-response in which the client proves possession of a registered key over a single-use nonce and the last event it saw. The event log is hash-chained. The contract complements, and does not replace, the protocols it composes with. The evidence for the specification is in a companion preprint; it comes from one author's implementations and is not independent confirmation.
